definitions.sampling: World before/after at labeled controller tick; catch and first-contact events retained separately.
definitions.leverage: alongYd/acrossYd: defender minus receiver projected on receiver achieved velocity; across uses left-normal (-uy,ux). Null at receiver speed <=.5 yd/s; heading also null if defender speed <=.5.
definitions.unrecognizedMan: Recorded man technique with flight inputs and no onBall tag after request.
definitions.grasp: First solved receiver grasp and its uninterrupted recorded episode; absence alone does not prove slipping/break.
definitions.support: FS/SS achieved geometry only; no claim of observed information, reachable help or sound assignment.
definitions.requestDetailScope: Full first-fork cues for man defenders of the actual catcher (intended target when no catch), both arms' first-contact defenders, and FS/SS. Other man forks retain time/identity/requests. All-man incidence is retained.
definitions.limits: Changed later bodies, contests and random draw ordering are not isolated. YAC alone is not a decision-quality verdict; no-contact/grasp=null is N/A, not tackle failure. Raw recording scopes can omit other defenders.

worldDefaults.substeps: adaptive 12-16 for nearby/contact bodies; 1 for isolated bodies
